build_transformer_lm_model: build a transformer language model using TransformerLanguageModel.build_model with a fairseq task and args
configure_transformer_lm_big_architectur: configure the transformer_lm_big architecture with 12 layers and 1024 embedding dimension
configure_transformer_lm_gpt_architectur: configure the transformer_lm_gpt architecture with 768 embedding dim and gelu activation
configure_transformer_lm_gpt2_big_archit: configure the transformer_lm_gpt2_big architecture with 48 layers and 1600 embedding dim
add_transformer_lm_args: add transformer language model specific arguments to an argparse parser using add_args
